TestCase.Analysis: Protocol Section 3.1 states: Phase 2 (STK/LTK generation) must follow a completed Phase 1 (Pairing Request/Response exchange). Protocol Section 4.3 states: LL Encryption Request must only be sent after successful STK/LTK generation in Phase 2.
TestCase.MutationSteps: 1. Send LL Feature Request → LL Length Request → LL Version Ind. 2. Send Pairing Request (Phase 1). 3. Skip Pairing Confirm and Pairing Random (Phase 2). 4. Directly send LL Encryption Request.
TestCase.Validation: ✔ Violates Prestate Not Completed (Phase 2 key generation steps omitted). ✔ Violates Encryption Handshake Process Specification.

TestCase.Analysis: Protocol Section 4.3 states: Encryption must be initiated only after Phase 2 completes with valid STK/LTK. Protocol Section 5.2 states: LL Encryption Request shall contain parameters derived from the Phase 2 key.
TestCase.MutationSteps: 1. Send Pairing Request (Phase 1). 2. Send LL Encryption Request before sending Pairing Confirm.
TestCase.Validation: ✔ Violates Prestate Not Completed (STK/LTK not generated). ✔ Encryption Request parameters are invalid due to missing key.

TestCase.Analysis: Protocol Section 6.1 states: Service discovery shall not interrupt active pairing phases. Protocol Section 3.3 states: Key distribution in Phase 3 must occur in a stable connection state.
TestCase.MutationSteps: 1. Send Pairing Request → Pairing Confirm → Pairing Random (Phases 1-2). 2. Initiate ATT_Find_Information_Request during Phase 3 (Key Distribution). 3. Send LL Pause Encryption Request.
TestCase.Validation: ✔ Violates Prestate Not Completed (Service discovery overlaps with key distribution). ✔ Causes resource contention in Security Manager.

TestCase.Analysis: Protocol Section 2.1 states: LL Feature Request/Response shall only occur once before Phase 1. Protocol Section 3.1 states: Pairing Request parameters are final after Phase 1 starts.
TestCase.MutationSteps: 1. Send LL Feature Request → LL Length Request → LL Version Ind. 2. Send Pairing Request (Phase 1). 3. Re-send LL Feature Request after Pairing Request.
TestCase.Validation: ✔ Violates Repeated Operations Not Following Protocol (duplicate Feature Request). ✔ Feature renegotiation during active pairing is prohibited.

TestCase.Analysis: Protocol Section 7.2 states: Connection parameter updates are prohibited during Phase 3 (Key Distribution). Protocol Section 4.4 states: Key distribution requires stable connection intervals.
TestCase.MutationSteps: 1. Complete Phases 1-2 (Pairing Request → Confirm → Random). 2. During Phase 3 (Key Distribution), send LL Connection Update Request. 3. Send LL Pause Encryption Request.
TestCase.Validation: ✔ Violates Prestate Not Completed (Key Distribution interrupted). ✔ Causes packet timing mismatches during critical security operations.
